fullPassage: Herbert Simon won his Nobel Prize for recognizing our limitations in information, time, and cognitive capacity. As we lack the resources to compute answers independently, we distribute the computation across the population and solve the answer slowly, generation by generation. Then all we have to do is socially learn the right answers. You don’t need to understand how your computer or toilet works; you just need to be able to use the interface and flush. All that needs to be transmitted is which button to push―essentially how to interact with technologies rather than how they work. And so instead of holding less information than we have mental capacity for and indeed need to know, we could dedicate our large brains to a small piece of a giant calculation. We understand things well enough to benefit from them, but all the while we are making small calculations that contribute to a larger whole. We are just doing our part in a larger computation for our societies’ collective brains.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
(A) 계산을 인구 전체에 '분산한다(distribute)'는 맥락 → concentrate(집중하다)는 반대

(B) '사회적으로(socially)' 정답을 학습한다는 맥락 → individually(개별적으로)는 반대

(C) 이해해서 '이익을 얻는다(benefit)'는 맥락 → suffer(고통받다)는 반대

따라서 distribute - socially - benefit 조합인 ④가 정답

det.analysis:
① how they work: '그것들이 어떻게 작동하는지' — 뒤에서 전달할 필요 없는 것으로 언급됨

② a giant calculation: '거대한 계산' — 문맥과 무관

③ the right answers: '정답' — 앞 문장 내용, 위치가 맞지 않음

④ which button to push: '어떤 버튼을 눌러야 하는지' — 전달되어야 하는 것은 작동 원리가 아니라 사용법이라는 맥락에 적절 ← 정답
det.tip: essentially 뒤 how to interact와 연결

questions.passage: Herbert Simon won his Nobel Prize for recognizing our limitations in information, time, and cognitive capacity. As we lack the resources to compute answers independently, we distribute the computation across the population and solve the answer slowly, generation by generation. Then all we have to do is socially learn the right answers. You don’t need to understand how your computer or toilet works; you just need to be able to use the interface and flush. All that needs to be transmitted is which button to push―essentially how to interact with technologies rather than how they work. And so instead of holding less information than we have mental capacity for and indeed need to know, we could dedicate our large brains to __________. We understand things well enough to benefit from them, but all the while we are making small calculations that contribute to a larger whole. We are just doing our part in a larger computation for our societies’ collective brains.
